```{python}
#| eval: true
def bimodal_dgf(rng, n):
    short = rng.random(n) < 0.3
    short_sample = rng.normal(loc=155, scale=3, size=n)
    tall_sample = rng.normal(loc=171, scale=3, size=n)
    return np.where(short, short_sample, tall_sample)
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
rng = np.random.default_rng(2023)
bimodal_sample = bimodal_dgf(rng, 1000)
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
(
    pl.DataFrame({"height": bimodal_sample})
    .ggplot()
    .aes(x="height")
    .geom_histogram(bins=30, color="black")
    .labs(x="Height", y="Count")
)
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
def get_means(rng, sample_size, n_samples, dgf):
    results = []
    for i in range(n_samples):
        sample = dgf(rng, sample_size)
        sample_mean = np.mean(sample)
        sample_se = np.std(sample, ddof=1) / np.sqrt(len(sample) - 1)
        results.append({
            'i': i,
            'mean': sample_mean,
            'se': sample_se,
            'z': sample_mean / sample_se
        })
    return pl.DataFrame(results)
```

```{python}
                                  dgf=bimodal_dgf)
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
def make_clt_plot(df):
    x = np.linspace(df["mean"].min(), df["mean"].max(), 100)
    normal_density = pl.DataFrame(
        {
            "mean": x,
            "density": stats.norm.pdf(
                x, df["mean"].mean(), df["mean"].std()
            ),
        }
    )

    return (
        df
        .ggplot(aes(x="mean"))
        .geom_histogram(
            aes(y=after_stat("density")),
            bins=50,
            fill="green",
            color="black",
        )
        .geom_vline(xintercept=df["mean"].mean(), color="red", size=1)
        .geom_line(
            data=normal_density,
            mapping=aes(x="mean", y="density"),
            color="blue",
            size=1,
        )
        .labs(x="Mean", y="Density")
    )
```


```{python}
def clt_demo(sample_size, n_samples, dgf):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(2023)
    df = get_means(rng, sample_size, n_samples, dgf)
    return make_clt_plot(df)
```

```{python}
def ols_fit(formula, data, **fit_kwargs):
    df = data.to_pandas()
    return smf.ols(formula, data=df).fit(**fit_kwargs)
```

```{python}
def rnorm_dgf(rng, n):
    return rng.normal(size=n)

rng = np.random.default_rng(2023)

sample_0_stats = get_means(
    rng,
    sample_size=1000,
    n_samples=10000,
    dgf=rnorm_dgf,
)

sample_1_stats = get_means(
    rng,
    sample_size=1000,
    n_samples=10000,
    dgf=rnorm_dgf,
)
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
merged_stats = (
    sample_0_stats
    .join(sample_1_stats, on="i", suffix="_1")
    .rename({"mean": "mean_0", "se": "se_0", "z": "z_0"})
    .with_columns(
        (pl.col("mean_1") - pl.col("mean_0")).alias("mean_diff"),
        (
            (pl.col("se_0") ** 2 + pl.col("se_1") ** 2).sqrt()
        ).alias("se_diff"),
    )
    .with_columns(
        z_diff=pl.col("mean_diff") / pl.col("se_diff")
    )
)
```

## Differences in means

### Discussion question

```{python}
#| echo: false
(
    merged_stats
    .with_columns(
        sig_diff=pl.col("z_diff").abs() > crit_value,
        sig_1=pl.col("z_1").abs() > crit_value,
        sig_0=pl.col("z_0").abs() > crit_value,
    )
    .with_columns(sig_diff_alt = (pl.col("sig_1") & ~pl.col("sig_0")) |
                                 (pl.col("sig_0") & ~pl.col("sig_1")))
    .select(
        prop_sig_diff=pl.col("sig_diff").mean(),
        prop_sig_diff_alt=pl.col("sig_diff_alt").mean(),
        prop_sig_diff_choice=(pl.col("sig_diff") |
                           pl.col("sig_diff_alt")).mean()
    )
    .with_columns(pl.all().round(4))
)
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
rng = np.random.default_rng(2021)
N = 1000
x = rng.normal(size=N)
e = rng.normal(scale=0.2, size=N)
y = x * 1 + e
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
X = np.column_stack([np.ones(N), x])
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
b = np.linalg.solve(X.T @ X, X.T @ y)
resid = y - X @ b
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
resvar = np.sum(resid**2) / (N - 2)
Sigma = resvar * np.linalg.inv(X.T @ X)
se = np.sqrt(np.diag(Sigma))
t_vals = b / se
p_vals = 2 * (1 - stats.t.cdf(np.abs(t_vals), df=N - 2))

(
    pl.DataFrame({'b': b, 'se': se, 't': t_vals, 'p': p_vals})
    .style
    .fmt_number(pl.all(), decimals=4)
)
```

```{python}
def get_bs_coefs(rng, data):
    rows = np.arange(len(data))
    bs_rows = rng.choice(rows, size=len(rows), replace=True)
    bs_sample = data[bs_rows]
    fm = ols_fit('y ~ x', data=bs_sample)
    return fm.params.to_dict()
```
